title: W-8: main and release tags are unprotected, and the release path does not require a gated dev
description: Source: the consolidated pre-public security review (opum-doc, 2026-10-30), reviewed at b1dae53374a8c0c3514f015ff77faac9af643e2d; tracked under ODOC-552 and parent WCLI-95. Report id: W-8 (medium). Protection exists only on dev. A token with write access can push a main commit and a matching tag, satisfy the workflow checks and publish a release; the release is mutable. Security-posture and release-path change: some parts are the operator's (settings) and need Opus review. Files: .github/workflows/release.yml.

acceptanceCriteria.text: main and tag creation, update and deletion are protected by ruleset
The publishing job is constrained to a protected environment
Immutable releases are considered and the decision recorded
